value.rationale: A natural infinite family consists of numerical semigroups whose entire middle layer below twice multiplicity is an initial consecutive interval. The fixed-point problem for the newly studied reflexive-ideal dual becomes a nontrivial local length-h avoidance condition. This gives a complete genus-resolved classification with an explicit rational series and binomial coefficients, rather than a numerical recomputation or arbitrary subcase. It sharpens the contrast between the h=1 and h=m-1 extremes and is usable to enumerate specific genera without enumerating all ideals.
